card.name: Last digit of a citation year
card.fires_on: The final digit of a four-digit year (or the comma right after it) in a citation, such as a journal reference, court case or regulation. It also fires on the last digit of volume or page numbers in references.

modes.label: Year ending in reference
modes.description: The last digit of a year inside a parenthetical or bibliographic citation.
modes.example: Wall, SM et al: Am J Kidney Dis 28(6): 846-854, 199<<6>>). Accidental intrathecal overdos

modes.label: Legal or regulatory number
modes.description: The last digit of a case-reporter page or an official journal number in a legal citation.

modes.label: Comma after botanical year
modes.description: The comma following a year in a taxonomic citation.
modes.example: Festuca texana Vasey, Bull. Torrey Bot. Club 13: 119. 1886<<,>> non Steud. Syn. Fl.

card.writes: It weakly promotes some unrelated tokens and suppresses 'become' words, so there is no clear link to the citation pattern.
card.plain: It lights up on the final digit of a year or number at the end of a reference citation.
